metadata.description: Fixed environmental sensors: 6 water-quality sondes, 20 air monitors, tide gauges, 2 stream gauges, weather stations, buoys, bridge wind sensors, wastewater sampling sites.
metadata.coordinates: Coordinates are real published points (reference/geo/landmarks.geojson) or points beside real roads; see position_basis on each record and reference/geo/SOURCES_*.md.
metadata.note: Outage and failure behaviour during the storm is not described here; it is in the data.
